requirements.title: api-base HTTP Integration
requirements.description: All HTTP REST calls (health, sessions CRUD) route through api-base resolveApiBase/buildApiUrl helpers. No hardcoded origins.

validation.notes: All REST calls use api-base URL builder

requirements.title: api-base WebSocket Integration
requirements.description: WebSocket connections for terminal I/O use api-base WS URL resolution. Connection upgrades work through reverse proxies.

validation.notes: WebSocket URL constructed through api-base resolver

requirements.title: Proxy Connection Upgrade
requirements.description: WebSocket upgrade requests route through reverse proxy without direct-origin assumptions. Connection negotiation handles proxy headers.

validation.notes: WebSocket URL resolution uses api-base WS helpers
